clips.caption:
Three products. Three rejections. One rival agency spent hundreds of thousands of dollars and failed all three.

Kevin Trudeau says everyone in the infomercial business had already written off these products: the world's fastest reader, a human calculator, a relationship course. A competitor tried first, burned through the marketing budget, and canceled all three contracts.

Nobody else would touch the products after that. Trudeau took all three, shot the ads in one morning, and every one became a hit - tens of millions of dollars each.

Same product. Same market. Only the message changed.

What are you blaming the product for that's actually a message problem?

#kevintrudeau #marketing #advertising #copywriting #entrepreneur #businessstory

Most people chasing a business idea start in the wrong place: with a product they already love.

Kevin Trudeau says that's backwards. The first question is never "what do I want to sell" - it's "what does a market already want?"

Campbell didn't invent a craving for soup. People already wanted it; they just didn't want to spend an hour making it from scratch. Campbell found the need, condensed the recipe, and let people add the water themselves.

Same old rule: if you want to get rich, don't invent a category. Build a better mousetrap for a market that already exists.

What market are you overlooking because you're attached to your own idea?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #marketing #smallbusiness #startuptips #wealthmindset

Larry King once asked Bill Gates, one of the richest men alive, what his secret was. Gates said luck - being in the right place at the right time.

Kevin Trudeau points out Gates didn't stop there. Plenty of people were in that same room in those same years. What set Gates apart was vision: he saw what a computer could become when most people around him saw a toy.

A friend once tested Trudeau's own vision with a pack of matches: imagine this is an acorn, what do you see? Trudeau said a tree. The friend said, I see a forest.

Luck puts you in the room. Vision decides what you build there.

#kevintrudeau #billgates #mindset #vision #entrepreneur #successmindset
